scope: Every RICH validation/ego index window: 206 windows from 27 eligible sequences; 28 source sequences include one short excluded source. Not TEST or an assumed external-paper protocol.

metric_protocol.joints: 22 common native SMPL/SMPL-X body joints, including pelvis; not a dataset official 14/17-joint regressor
metric_protocol.w_mpjpe_mm: World coordinates, no alignment; existing mpjpe_cm times 10
metric_protocol.root_relative_mpjpe_mm: Subtract each frame pelvis separately from prediction and GT; no rotation or scale alignment
metric_protocol.pa_mpjpe_mm: Per-frame proper rotation (no reflection), positive similarity scale and translation; all 22 joints
metric_protocol.mpjve_mm_s: World joint first-difference velocity error at explicit 30Hz, mm/s; no alignment
metric_protocol.acceleration_error_mm_s2: World joint second-difference acceleration error at explicit 30Hz, mm/s^2; no alignment
metric_protocol.temporal_boundaries: Only within each saved window, no differences across window boundaries; overlapping windows retained

timing_scope: Concurrent single GPU: evaluation and training throughput can differ from isolated measurements.
